comment: People v3 WS-B connection-score v2 weights (services/score_v2.py). Damping is log1p normalized so ONE unit of evidence scores like v1; provenance multiplies each evidence item before damping (user-asserted > document > ASR). mention_cap_ratio bounds the mention term to a fraction of relationship evidence (typed + asserted + dialogue + co-occurrence): mentions corroborate, they never dominate a rank. 0.4 keeps mention share <= 28.6% of any score, under the 30% spec gate.
